描述_EN: the embroidered decoration was carried out in 1585-1587 by claude de luz, the king's ordinary embroiderer. other cl no. 18551 interior slope of the canopy of the chapel of the order of the holy spirit (ms 64 6, composed of ms 64 7 to ms 64 11) presented on the reverse of ms 64 9paris, 1585-1587the ornaments intended for the ceremonies of the order of the holy spirit founded in 1578 by henri iii, king of france and poland, were executed in gold lamé fabric on a green ground delivered in 1585 by pierre le grand and macé papillon, merchants supplying the king's silverware.
描述_ZN: 刺绣装饰是在1585-1587年由国王的普通刺绣师克劳德-德-卢斯制作的。 其他编号18551 圣灵会教堂天幕的内坡（MS 64 6，由MS 64 7至MS 64 11组成），呈现在MS 64 9的背面巴黎，1585-1587为法国和波兰国王亨利三世于1578年建立的圣灵会的仪式准备的装饰品，由提供国王银器的商人Pierre le Grand和Macé Papillon于1585年在绿色地面上用金丝绒面料制作。
